analysis.title: GS U.S. Industrials & Materials | EPS rundown ...
key_insights: Desk's trading thoughts after Q3 prints on 11/3/26: Better: AME, DD, ETN. Worse: BALL, GPK, KNF. Mixed: ADM, APTV, LDOS, LPX, RRX, ZBRA.

ZBRA was the most asked-about name, indicated down 10% pre-market on small volume. Organic growth was 11% with flat EBITDA margins, and the stock had been hovering near highs after last quarter's squeeze. Memory costs were cited, which drove fear into the print last week. ZBRA initiated additional pricing in early October to mitigate into 2027. The desk says the numbers look in line and the name is very debated.
ETN beat and raised on organic growth strength but margins remain mixed. The bar was lowered across electrical equipment, and the desk will wait for the call to see if that is enough for ETN.
ETN's 2027 end-market outlook is constructive vs. consensus: management expects overall end-market growth of ~11%, and consensus has ETN topline growing 11% in 2027, which implies no outgrowth.

ETN expects strong/double-digit 2027 growth in Data Centers & Distributed IT (21% of 2025 sales) and Commercial Aerospace (9%). Utility (11%), Commercial & Institutional (20%), Industrial Facilities (11%), Machinery/MOEM (5%), Defense Aerospace (6%) and Commercial Vehicles (6%) are expected to post moderate growth. ICE and EV Light Vehicles (5%) and Residential (6%) are expected to be ~flat.

ADM raised full-year EPS guidance to $5.50-5.80 from $5.15-5.60 on better operating profit in all segments, and guided capex to the low end of $1.2-1.3bn. The desk calls it better but expected, with the stock at a big level on the 200-day.

AME beat and raised. Full-year EPS guidance is $8.53-8.57 vs. $8.20-8.30 prior. The release had no order growth numbers after 20%+ order growth in the last two quarters. The bar was high, so the call decides the reaction.
APTV beat Q3 but guided Q4 EPS $1.35-1.55, below the $1.61 consensus. The desk thinks the lower Q4 outweighs the Q3 beat, pending the macro, and notes fears around Europe and China across the space.
BALL beat Q3 EPS and revenue. The stock is at the high end of its range and short interest is high. The desk does not think the print is enough before the call.

DD beat Q3 EPS ($2.09 vs. $1.80-1.90 guidance) and guided Q4 above consensus. The desk calls it solid, and the question is whether DD can get out of its current investor coverage and migrate into multis.
GPK beat Q3 and raised the sales outlook to the high end of $8.6bn but cut EBITDA to the low end of $1.05bn and EPS to $0.65. The desk frames the debate as low expectations vs. lower estimates.
KNF missed Q3 EBITDA ($272mm vs. $280mm consensus) and cut full-year sales and EBITDA guidance. The desk says a miss and cut is unlikely to be well received.
LDOS beat Q3 EPS and EBITDA and raised full-year EPS guidance but lowered revenue guidance. The desk says it is navigating the chop and this is not a clearing event for LDOS or the group.
LPX beat Q3 EPS and EBITDA and raised full-year EBITDA guidance to $270-280mm. The Q4 guide is below consensus and OSB headwinds continue. Short interest is very elevated.

RRX beat Q3 sales and EPS, but EPS ex refunds of $2.72 is more in line. Full-year guidance is up but includes IEEPA benefits. The desk says the stock has settled at a lower level and questions remain for the call.
ZBRA technical levels: breaking the 50-day will not help, and the desk is watching the $329 100-day.
GS hosts an earnings callback with LHX on 11/3 at 3pm. Upcoming GS events run through 12/10, including the GS Industrials and Materials Conference on 12/2-12/3.

sector_views.rationale: Desk sees Q3 earnings as not a clearing event for the group. Fears around Europe and China are rampant across the space, and the bar was lowered across electrical equipment.

earnings_insights: ADM Q3 EPS reported $1.77 vs. $1.60 consensus, revenue $22.34bn vs. $23.27bn consensus, EBITDA $1.53bn vs. $1.38bn consensus (reported 11/3). Full-year EPS guidance raised to $5.50-5.80 from $5.15-5.60 prior.

AME Q3 EPS reported $2.21 vs. $2.11 consensus, sales $2.22bn vs. $2.13bn consensus (reported 11/3). Full-year EPS guidance $8.53-8.57 vs. $8.20-8.30 prior. Q4 EPS guide $2.26-2.30 with sales up in the low 20% range.

APTV Q3 EPS reported $1.42 vs. $1.33 consensus, revenue $3.2bn vs. $3.17bn consensus, EBITDA $567mm vs. $560mm (reported 11/3). Q4 EPS guide $1.35-1.55 vs. $1.61 consensus on sales $3.11-3.21bn vs. $3.19bn. Full-year EPS guide $5.60-5.80 vs. $5.66 consensus on sales $12.65-12.75bn.

BALL Q3 EPS reported $1.10 vs. $1.07 consensus, revenue $4.19bn vs. $3.78bn consensus (reported 11/3). NA beat topline and EBIT, EMEA beat sales but missed EBIT, South America beat topline and EBIT with overall margins below.

DD Q3 EPS reported $2.09 vs. $1.80-1.90 company guidance (the desk's revenue comparison of $2.87bn vs. $1.835bn is as printed in the note). EBITDA $469mm vs. $448mm consensus. Q4 guide EPS $1.90-1.95 vs. $1.87 consensus, revenue $1.825bn, EBITDA $455mm vs. $451mm (reported 11/3).

ETN Q3 EPS reported $3.68 vs. $3.55 consensus, sales $8.95bn vs. $8.52bn consensus (reported 11/3). Q4 EPS guide $4.05-4.15, in line. Full-year EPS $13.70-13.80 vs. $13.40-13.60 prior and full-year organic growth of $13-15% as printed. TTM organic orders +39% in Electrical Americas, +51% in Electrical global and +20% in aerospace.

GPK Q3 EPS reported $0.23 vs. $0.21 consensus, sales $2.19bn vs. $2.17bn, EBITDA $289mm vs. $283mm consensus (reported 11/3). Full-year sales to the high end of $8.6bn, EBITDA to the low end of $1.05bn, EPS $0.65 vs. $0.65-0.90 prior.

KNF Q3 EBITDA reported $272mm vs. $280mm consensus, sales $1.28bn vs. $1.3bn consensus (reported 11/3). Full-year sales guide cut to $3.375-3.425bn from $3.4-3.6bn, EBITDA guide cut to $475-505mm from $520-560mm.

LDOS Q3 EPS reported $3.62 vs. $3.03, revenue $4.63bn vs. $4.71bn consensus (miss), EBITDA $644mm vs. $615mm consensus (reported 11/3). Full-year EPS guide raised to $12.50-12.70 from $12.20-12.50, revenue guide lowered to $18-18.2bn from $18.2-18.4bn, CFO guide $1.9bn vs. $1.85bn prior.

LPX Q3 EPS reported $0.39 vs. $0.20, revenue $691mm vs. $671mm, EBITDA $82mm vs. $63mm (reported 11/3). Q4 EBITDA guide $30-40mm vs. $53mm with OSB EBITDA loss of $35mm. Full-year EBITDA guide raised to $270-280mm from $255-270mm.

RRX Q3 EPS reported $2.91 vs. $2.67 ($2.72 ex refunds), sales $1.59bn vs. $1.56bn, EBITDA $351mm vs. $343mm (reported 11/3). Daily orders +5.7% vs. 6% organic sales growth. Full-year EPS guide $10.75 vs. $10.60 prior, including IEEPA benefits.
ZBRA Q3 EPS reported $4.95 vs. $4.91 consensus, sales $1.61bn, EBITDA $349mm vs. $346mm consensus (reported 11/3). Q4 EPS guide $5-5.40 vs. $5.18 consensus on sales growth of 10-14%.
